faqs.q: What rewards does IDBI Bank Imperium Platinum Credit Card offer?
faqs.a: IDBI Bank Imperium Platinum Credit Card offers 2 Delight Points per Rs. 150 spent on shopping, movies, travel and other lifestyle purchases for everyday spending.

faqs.q: Is there any welcome benefit on IDBI Bank Imperium Platinum Credit Card?
faqs.a: IDBI Bank Imperium Platinum offers 500 Delight Points on Rs. 1,500 spend within 30 days or 300 points if spent between 31 and 90 days of activation.

faqs.q: What are the fees for an IDBI Bank Imperium Platinum Credit Card?
faqs.a: IDBI Bank Imperium Platinum charges Rs. 499 plus taxes as joining and annual fee, which can be waived on annual spends of Rs. 75,000.

faqs.q: Does this card offer fuel benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, the card offers 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 4,000, capped at Rs. 300 per month.

faqs.q: Who should apply for this card?
faqs.a: IDBI Bank Imperium Platinum Credit Card is suitable for new-to-credit individuals who are not eligible for unsecured cards, seeking basic rewards while building credit history.
